name: sonic-engine
step: v12-flight 7: the sound engine in a real page (SonicSetup, the one AudioContext from a click, the tap in front of the destination)
note: headless Chrome runs muted (--mute-audio): the graph is rendered and measured, nothing is played; how it sounds is not judged here

checks.name: no AudioContext before the press
engine idle before the press
one AudioContext after the press
the context runs and the engine runs
the engine's input node exists (the motor sound plugs in there)
the audio clock advances (the graph is being rendered)
layers off, frames running: the output is silent (RMS under 1e-4)
a wall 3 m ahead closing at 3 m/s: the output has sound (RMS over 2e-3)
the engine names an active safety cue
the output holds the ceiling: peak at or under -6 dBFS (0.5012)
frames stopped and setLayers({ on: [] }): the output is silent again (RMS under 1e-4)
a loud signal into the engine's input node comes out at or under the ceiling (peak <= 0.5013)
control: the same signal straight at the destination is not limited (peak over 0.9)
the motor sound on the engine's input node is heard (RMS over 1e-3, silent before)
and it stays under the ceiling (peak <= 0.5013)
closing the motor sound leaves the context running and the output silent
still one AudioContext
a spoken line is captioned (the engine's text, English)
the engine speaks (default): the captions region is shown and not live, so a screen reader does not say it twice
"my screen reader speaks": the region is a polite live region
the line is still captioned when the engine does not voice it
captions hidden from the eye but a screen reader still reads them: visually hidden, still live
the engine speaks and captions are off: nothing on the page, no line kept
a setting out of range is refused and changes nothing
no console errors, no missing file but the favicon
